subject: gatehouse
note: Quality-varied climb-state corpus for diagnosing the creation-loop accept-rule (per-move median + floor-only batch) against a human glance-rank. References on-disk T-208/T-211 trajectory states + beside renders; copies the rule-input fields verbatim from those trajectory JSONs (single source of truth). Validates the creation-loop accept-rule, NEVER the frozen DiagnoseBuild scorer.

glanceRank.source: agent-vision-glance over the on-disk renders vs concept.png, pending human confirmation
glanceRank.comment: worst -> best. Mass-level reads (pale stone field, the gable roof, the centered arch) weighted over minor banding/slits, as a glance does.
glanceRank.contestableNote: S4 has a crisp centered arch but is dark and roofless; S5 has roof + pale stone (mass-level) but a weaker arch. Ranked S5>S4 (a roofed pale mass reads as 'the picture' more than a dark roofless box-with-a-hole). A human may flip this one adjacency; it does NOT change the headline (both S4 and S5 are KEEP-worthy moves the current rule rolled back).

states.label: seed open colonnade (roofless, ragged, no walls)
closed dark box (form reads; dark, no quoins, no roof, no gate)
states.renderlessNote: close_shell was kept but never rendered standalone; glance position inferred from the trajectory (closed form, no detail). Scored 0.

states.label: dark box + partial gable (a roof begins; dark, no quoins, no gate)
states.renderlessNote: apply_gable_roof was rolled back, never rendered standalone; glance position inferred (roof mass added over the box).

+ centered arched gate (dark walls + quoins + the defining gatehouse feature; dark, roofless)
+ dressed compound: PALE walls + quoins + gabled ROOF (most concept-like mass the climb produced)
states.staleClosureNote: This state is from the T-208 run, which executed BEFORE the T-209 relief-tolerant closure fix. The recorded closureAfter=0.068 is a FALSE reopen (the old eaveRingClosure folded the relief into the perimeter). T-209 (held in T-211, closure stayed 1.000 through dressing) makes the corrected closure >=0.9 -> use closureAfterCorrected for the current-rule replay.

moves.recordedReason: compound tie at floor — no read (single-pick batch at floor; construct_walls form-move broke the batch)
moves.disagreement: median([0,12,0])=0 discards the 12; rolled back a roof move the glance keeps.

moves.fromNote: after M2 (gable) rolled back, the build is the S1 closed box; construct_walls dressed it to S3.

moves.disagreement: THE HEADLINE. median([8,0,48])=8 vs before 8 -> delta 0 -> tie-no-shrink -> rollback. The 48 (a judge seeing the centered arch land) is discarded. The build that looks MOST like the concept's defining feature is thrown away.

moves.excludedNote: No standalone render; a recess-only frame on the gate void after the arch was rolled back. median([8,0,0])=0 -> regressed -8. Excluded from the agreement fraction (cannot glance it honestly).

moves.disagreement: Under the recorded STALE closure the batch is rejected (the bug T-209 fixed). Under T-209-corrected closure (>=0.9) the batch ACCEPTS (compound +20 off the floor) — BUT only because S5 was reached AT the score floor. The same dressing reached OFF the floor (T-211, after construct_walls' +8) gets the per-move median gate and is rolled back. The floor-only-batch asymmetry.

agreementSpec.definition: For each applied move: glanceVerdict = keep iff rank(to) > rank(from). ruleVerdict = the current accept-rule's recomputed decision. agreement = fraction of (non-excluded) moves where the two match.
agreementSpec.frozenInstrument: untouched — this validates the creation-loop accept-rule (acceptsRound/acceptsBatch), never the frozen DiagnoseBuild scorer.
